answer: Locks are written down in terrace, expire in quartz, and pulse lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 127 aliases thus needs 122 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4252 identities would post 1094 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
